ready for a height
that had to arrive

stayed above

lower
than water
was expected
to reach.

North
of the north curb
of Bridge Street,

a line kept copper
above the sidewalk.

Behind the office,
the staff waited

The zero stayed
below the missing.

from which
it will be read.
